rationale: T10 Indonesian Whisper Base clean ASR WER is 105/367=28.61035%, failing <=20% official target. Previous attempts: gain-only on two listener-ambiguous clips showed no improvement; beam size 1 full 20-pair diagnostic worsened to 110/367. Choose genuinely different Whisper multilingual model capacity using quantized small q5_1 to reduce download/staging burden.

control.name: Whisper multilingual Base GGML full precision

candidate.name: Whisper multilingual Small q5_1 quantized
candidate.approx_download: 190-200 MB, billed network data; download manually opt-in on Wi-Fi; downloaded via --prepare-small only

models.whisper_cli_version_expected: whisper.cpp v1.9.4 (cached existing Android arm64 build; binary SHA recorded per session)

data.source: 20 pre-existing Indonesian clean FLEURS human-speech WAVs, exactly same source reference for both models; five clips previously listener-marked AUDIO_AMBIGUOUS remain included
data.study_limitation: Previously inspected dataset is NOT independent unseen validation; full 20 pairs only exploratory model screening.

protocol.hardware: Sony SO-03L Android 11 arm64; Android /data/local/tmp isolated directory, no overwrite original gate files
protocol.session: new .t10-benchmark/small-model-ab-<UTC>-<random> path, gitignored; report summary.json and runs.csv
protocol.host: Windows with Python 3 and ADB; --prepare-small online, --preflight-only and live inference strictly offline
protocol.order: alternating model per clip base,small / small,base across all 20 chronological sorted clips
protocol.inference_flags: same whisper.cpp -l id -nt -ng -nfa -otxt -of result for both
protocol.measurements: full transcript and S/D/I total WER, sample-level and aggregate errors, elapsed/RTF, sampled Android process VmRSS, battery temperature before/during/after
protocol.safety: cold battery <40C, abort temperature >=43C, 240-second timeout per inference and 900 seconds per invocation, require >=600 MiB data free space, isolated process PID kill and isolated scratch cleanup
protocol.workflow: Start optional --prepare-small (online, pinned SHA), then offline --preflight-only; --max-pairs 2 default; optional --resume SESSION to 20 pairs, no initial long compulsory run.
protocol.max_source_wav_audio_upload: No raw WAV or model files committed; local artifacts gitignored.
